name: inspect_with_objdump
description: Run caller-selected GNU objdump inspection against a local artifact, or request operation=architectures without a path to list BFD targets advertised by the installed binary. Preserves decoded stdout and stderr inline with SHA-256 Evidence for artifact inspections, up to a shared 16 MiB combined limit; invalid UTF-8 bytes are represented by replacement characters and flagged in Evidence limitations. output_truncated reports output beyond that limit and completion_status is unknown if buffer enforcement terminated the process. The raw output is authoritative and REA does not claim a stable normalized format. DWARF does not follow local debug links by default. Set follow_debug_links to true to follow them; identities of external debug files are not bound to Evidence. REA clears DEBUGINFOD_URLS for objdump so DWARF processing does not make debuginfod network requests. Architecture output is subjectless and does not establish support for any artifact.

parameters.description: Provide a complete input group: path + operation + [follow_debug_links]; operation.

path.description: Local filesystem path used by this operation.
